standard_prerequisites.name: Structural facts of the derivability relation
standard_prerequisites.use: Weakening for the easy direction; the identity derivation for the A -> A basis case.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 642-645): Gamma union {A} proves B if and only if Gamma proves A -> B.
Easy direction (proof lines 647-652): weakening gives the premise set the implication, reflexivity gives A, and one application of prop:mp closes.

Induction on derivation length (lines 654-688): the basis handles B in Gamma, B an axiom (via ax:lif1 and MP), and B = A (via the identity derivation ex:identity); the inductive step takes the derivation ending in MP from C -> B and C, applies the induction hypothesis to both shorter derivations, and closes with the Hilbert schema instance A -> ((C -> B) -> ((A -> C) -> (A -> B))) of ax:lif2 and two applications of MP.
proof_roadmap: Basis: member, axiom, and B = A cases.
Inductive step: MP case through the ax:lif2 schema instance.
difficulty_reason: Deduction theorem (statement 642-645, proof 647-688): full induction on derivation length with all basis cases and the MP step carried through an explicit Hilbert schema instance. H2.
